sections.title: Sound of letter Pe
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (Pe) /peː/. Its main sound is heard in (Papa) /ˈpaːpa/, which means dad. This letter makes two sounds in German.

sections.title: How to say Pe
paragraphs: Close both lips firmly and stop the air. Release the air with a strong burst and a small puff. Keep your vocal cords still so the sound is voiceless. For the second sound, release the lips without that puff of air. Hold your hand before your mouth to feel the puff.

sections.title: Spelling rules for Pe
paragraphs: At the start of a word or stressed syllable, say it with a puff of air as in (Post) /pʰɔst/. After an s sound or in an unstressed syllable, release the lips cleanly without extra air as in (Sport) /ʃpɔʁt/. In the word (Knospe) /ˈknɔspə/, it follows an s and has no puff.

sections.title: Pitfalls with Pe
paragraphs: Do not turn this letter into a voiced sound like the b in bat. Keep your voice completely off. Do not drop the sharp puff of air at the start of words, like the p in pin. Release your lips crisply every time.
